meta.name: Parchhayee Ghost Stories by Ruskin Bond
meta.description:
This winter, there's no escaping the shivers as ZEE5 Original 'Parchhayee' is all set to bring to life the most bone-chilling horror tales of celebrated author Ruskin Bond. The mysteries unravel from 15th January! Here's a first look at 'Parchhayee'.

Rated U/A 16+ · Ended · First aired 15 Jan 2019 · India · Language: Hindi · 45 min
Studio: Banijay Asia, Opus Communications · Network: ZEE5

Not complete. On your server: S1 9/12 (missing E10-12)

On your server — Audio: Hindi (from file names)

videos.title: The Ghost in The Garden!
videos.overview: Rose keeps strolling in the garden, she loves to dance around and wander off in the woods…But is she planning a revenge by kidnapping the kids? Are these mysterious kidnapping truly paranormal or are an act of vicious minds??

videos.title: The Wind on The Haunted Hill
videos.overview: Usha is forced to take shelter in the ruins after being caught in a downpour. She doesn't know that her younger siblings are in the ruins. As lightning illuminates the dark interiors of the ruins, the children see ghostly figures.

videos.title: The Overcoat
videos.overview: The Suspense, the thrill, the spookiness is back again with the Third Chapter from Ruskin Bond’s Ghost stories. UK returned Nick attends the party on a frosty night to meet his old friends. At the party, he meets Julie, a beautiful girl, aloof, enjoying the her own, he spends the evening with her. On her way back, Nick gives his ‘overcoat’ to her as the night is snowy and asks her to meet him the next morning to return the coat. Will Julie ever be able to return his overcoat? The mystery unfolds only on ZEE5!

videos.title: Wilson’s Bridge
videos.overview: Rose was strolling in the garden, sometimes by herself and sometimes partnered by other ghosts! What is her mystery? Get ready for a haunting account by Ruskin Bond.

videos.title: Astley Ka Intezaar
videos.overview: A loyal caretaker of a castle continues to wait for his master, who went missing 30 years ago. Will the master, Robert Astley, ever return or is he already present in the castle? Watch this thrilling episode starring Shakti Kapoor and Vikram Kochhar.

videos.title: Qatl-E-Aam
videos.overview: Rahul, a writer, checks into the Ritz hotel which had witnessed a massacre hundreds of years ago. Will Rahul unravel the mystery of the haunted hotel? Enjoy this spine-chilling episode starring Puneet Issar in never seen before role.

videos.title: Topaz
videos.overview: Jayant, an engineer on a forest survey, along with his guide Sridhar, encounters more than just the forest’s wildlife and villagers. People warn Jayant not to venture deep in the forest as anything can happen in the depths of the foliage. Will the jungle be a friend or foe to Jayant?

videos.title: Ganpat's Story
videos.overview: Ganpat, a crime scene photographer, comes across a mystical diamond which leads him to Lavani, a lustful ghost. Lavani promises to make him rich provided he fulfils her wish. Will Ganpat get consumed by greed and lust?

videos.title: Night of the Millennium
videos.overview: Jimmy is keen to buy a beautiful mansion which supposedly is haunted. He ignores the rumours and one night decides to check out the place himself. With a beautiful lady for company, Jimmy spends an unforgetful night when the mystery unfolds. Enjoy this thrilling episode starring Naveen Kasturia and Gauhar Khan.
